shorts.title: The Ghost Ship Mary Celeste 👻 Case #12
shorts.description:
What if I told you a ship was found sailing the Atlantic with no one aboard? The Mary Celeste left New York for Genoa on 7 November 1872 and was found deserted near the Azores on 4 December, seaworthy and well stocked, her lifeboat gone. Nine of 1,701 barrels of alcohol were empty. Arthur Conan Doyle's 1884 story renamed her 'Marie Celeste', and that spelling stuck.
